summary: The five support orbits are correct and disjoint under exactly the allowed row-1/row-2 and column-2/column-3 interchanges. The first orbit meets the permutation-normal-form hypothesis of accepted fact b894a3da1107beaf, while the second orbit meets the precise open-chamber hypothesis of accepted fact 76bff99d5eaaa46f; the allowed interchanges preserve every other hypothesis. Removing those two orbits leaves exactly the three representatives claimed. Permutations preserve zero entries, and both exclusions require strict open-sign data, so every feasible zero-entry boundary stratum remains outside the conclusion.
